verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a terse feature-page mention of "Global and project-level configuration" listed alongside SAML & SSO. That loosely implies administrative and access controls scoped at the project level, but never names permissions or roles. SSO covers authentication, not who can view or edit work. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of permission schemes and roles, separate view vs. edit controls, issue-level security, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
